scenes.designSignature: A full-bleed tavern portrait with a quiet lower-left editorial headline; the menu becomes an overlapping letterpress page beside the room photograph.
A bright counter-service poster with a tilted food-photo frame, oversized block type, and menu items arranged like punchy takeaway tickets.
A café journal spread with an arched window of coffee photography, a restrained serif column, and a notebook-like menu that sits beside a photo postcard.
A pizzeria tabletop composition with a circular overhead pizza photograph, headline orbiting the image, and a menu styled as a long oven ticket.
A late-night doorway composition with a tall service photograph, vertical rule and italic headline; the drinks list appears over a full-bleed atmospheric image.
A bakery market sheet with a wide human bread photograph, flour-paper headline panel, and a menu laid out like labeled counter shelves.
A chopstick-thin vertical stripe and a circular overhead bowl create a compact street-poster landing; the menu reads like a column of paper order slips.
A wide scalloped ocean window and fine rule lines make the seafood photograph feel like a contemporary harbor poster; the menu becomes an airy dockside ledger.
A narrow cinematic wine-glass panel sits beside oversized italic editorial type; the menu is a restrained dark tasting card with fine metallic rules.
A checkerboard rail frames a sunny overhead toast photograph and condensed marquee type; the menu is a stack of cheerful receipt-style rows.
A bright cantina interior becomes a full-bleed collage behind staggered headline blocks; the menu uses bold color-banded cards inspired by lively restaurant graphics.
A minimal ink-on-paper introduction leaves a long, low sashimi photograph as the focal line; the menu is a quiet ruled sheet with deliberate spacing.
An angular hard-edged food photograph cuts through a charcoal field under monumental slab type; the menu is a high-contrast grill ledger.
A circular dessert portrait floats over a pale gradient with tiny offset labels; the menu becomes a patisserie display of delicate ruled rows.
A soft leaf-shaped salad photograph overlaps an airy botanical field; the menu uses a split garden-journal composition with generous white space.
A sweeping diagonal gnocchi photograph interrupts an oversized old-world serif headline; the menu is a warm tablecloth-style page beside the plate.
A striped storefront-style canopy crowns a bold cone photograph and bouncy rounded type; the menu is a row of flavor cards with playful rule marks.
A market produce photograph is framed like a torn newspaper clipping against an earthy field; the menu reads as a simple harvest bulletin with stacked cards.
A folded-paper menu motif surrounds a close-up dumpling portrait; a second food frame peeks through like another page, while the sample menu unfolds in two offset columns.
A sunny overhead breakfast table anchors a diagonal sunrise panel; a second waffle photograph sits like a clipped postcard and the menu becomes a cheerful weekend newspaper.
Industrial coffee equipment fills a strong vertical frame beside small technical labels; a creamy espresso inset softens the composition and the menu reads like a roaster tasting card.
An oyster platter sits inside a scalloped shell frame with a second seafood image as a small tide-window; the menu uses fine coastal rules and a broad photographic edge.
A dark charcoal field and an angled grilling photograph bring the fire forward; a narrow skewer strip cuts across the headline and the menu is built from bold butcher-paper rows.
A colorful shared plate and a bread-basket inset sit on an open linen-like gradient; a quiet invitation leads to a generous menu arranged like place cards.
A teapot photograph is framed as a narrow ritual panel and balanced by a second cup image; the menu rests on quiet paper with fine vertical measure marks.
A double-burger hero becomes a punchy sticker over a playful checker field; a second food photo overlaps like a takeaway card and the menu is a stack of bold numbered tickets.
A fresh dish and a second plate form an asymmetrical mosaic with botanical rules; the menu uses an airy two-panel composition that keeps ingredients in view.
A bustling stall photograph is cropped into stacked signboards while a second cooking scene animates the lower edge; the menu becomes a wayfinding board of bold rows.
A dramatic pastry photograph floats in a rounded display window with a second sweet vignette; the menu uses patisserie labels and a polished counter rhythm.
A documentary cooking photograph leads a split-screen pass with a second kitchen-detail window; the menu sits like a clear chef’s board beside the work.

rationale: Compared the existing thirty local compositions. Retained their food and place motifs while replacing fixed mobile positions with content-driven grids. Chose immersive photography, framed food portraits, and headline-first editorial sequences. Desktop menus use letterpress overlaps, ledgers, tickets, and shelves. No claim of global originality.

scenes.designSignature: An uninterrupted dining-room photograph introduces a large editorial headline. On mobile the invitation sits over a directional scrim; desktop pairs an overlapping letterpress menu with the room, keeping the table visible.

A tilted sandwich poster leads the mobile page, followed by compact block type; desktop gives each its own column. The menu uses a broad masthead and numbered takeaway tickets with offset accent edges.

An arched café photograph leads a quiet mobile reading sequence and a left-hand desktop portrait. The menu is a ruled notebook beside a photographic postcard, with room for the restaurant name to grow.

A circular overhead pizza photograph forms a tabletop motif. Mobile places the invitation beneath the plate; desktop separates it from the headline and pairs a round menu photograph with a slightly tilted order sheet.

A tall arched cocktail photograph and italic invitation establish an evening doorway. The menu sits on translucent dark paper over bar photography, with consistent readable text and fine light borders.

A bread photograph meets an overlapping counter card on mobile and a staggered photograph-and-card composition on desktop. A panoramic menu photograph leads three shelf-like menu labels on wider screens.

A bowl photograph forms a round noodle-shop sign beside a chopstick rule. Compact block type stays below the image on mobile; the menu is a narrow order slip with dashed rows and a separate food photograph.
A scalloped seafood photograph makes a broad mobile horizon. Desktop places the photo before the invitation and stretches a coastal menu photograph beside a compact, finely ruled ledger.
A narrow wine-glass portrait and italic headline create a cellar-like opening. The desktop photograph occupies a smaller column; the menu is a dark tasting card beside a luminous vertical strip.

Checker trim sits above a tilted breakfast postcard and short block headline. The mobile menu stays easy to scan; desktop gives the receipt-style rows and breakfast photograph separate columns under a broad masthead.

A lively restaurant interior fills the opening behind a dark scrim and a high-contrast signboard headline. The menu contrasts a tilted room photograph with banded food rows; the accent hue never determines text contrast.

Quiet typography leads both screen sizes, followed by a long sashimi photograph. Desktop puts supporting copy beside the headline; the menu uses double rules, restrained paper, and a separate photographic strip.
An angular steak photograph is separated from monumental type. The mobile menu uses an accent-edged grill ledger; desktop aligns the photograph and ledger beneath an oversized masthead.
A rounded dessert portrait and fine italic number form a delicate display. The photograph and invitation sit in separate desktop columns; a dotted menu list is paired with a tall pastry window.

A leaf-shaped food photograph leads the mobile page and the left side of the desktop opening. The menu uses a field-notebook edge and a second leaf-shaped photograph, keeping ingredients present throughout.
A diagonal pasta photograph sets a warm tabletop mood without crossing the text. The menu pairs a framed photograph with a subtly striped linen sheet; each grows with its content.

A striped canopy frames a cone portrait above a cheerful mobile invitation. Desktop expands the portrait beside the headline; rounded flavor labels and a curved menu photograph repeat the ice-cream-counter motif.
A produce photograph is framed as a newspaper clipping with a dashed stamp. The mobile invitation follows the image; desktop pairs a market bulletin with a tall produce photograph.

Two food photographs overlap as folded cards inside a reserved image area. The mobile headline stays below both cards; desktop gives image and copy separate columns, followed by a dashed menu sheet and food portrait.
A diagonal breakfast panorama and a clipped waffle postcard form a sunrise composition. An accent rule anchors the headline; the menu combines a broad food photograph and a bright breakfast card.

A commercial coffee-machine strip and a cream-topped espresso inset form a measured industrial composition. Block type remains separate; a compact tasting card and coffee photograph sit beneath a broad desktop menu masthead.
A scalloped oyster photograph overlaps a circular seafood detail within one image area. The coastal invitation stays clear of both; the menu pairs fine rules with a broad shell-like photograph.

A grill photograph fills the opening, with a small skewer detail above the headline on mobile and to its right on desktop. The menu uses butcher-paper rules and an accent edge beside the grilling photograph.
A relaxed tabletop photograph and circular bread-basket detail share a contained linen composition. The invitation stays separate; a framed menu photograph balances a generous, quiet menu sheet.
The invitation leads before a teapot and cup pair on mobile. Desktop places the quiet headline beside tall vessel photographs; the menu uses fine double rules alongside a softly arched tea image.
Checker trim and two food-photo stickers form a punchy burger-stand composition. Text stays below the photos on mobile and beside them on desktop; bold numbered tickets carry the menu.
Two ingredient photographs form an asymmetric mosaic, with a deliberate focal crop and botanical rule. The menu pairs a lightly ruled sheet with a large curved food photograph.

A street-market cooking photograph fills the opening behind a clear wayfinding sign. A second cooking detail stays above the mobile headline or beside it on desktop; the menu uses bold rules beneath a broad masthead.
A curved pastry window overlaps a small circular dessert detail within the image area. The invitation follows on mobile and sits alongside on desktop; dotted menu rules echo patisserie labels.
A documentary cooking photograph fills the opening, with a separate kitchen-detail window and a clear text scrim. The menu places the working kitchen beside an accent-edged chef’s pass sheet.
